Kyrios

Soldiers of Erenor look to Kyrios, the god of death and destruction, as their patron. In his name a battlerager charges into the thick of the fight, closes the distance with leaps and pulls and cuts down everything within reach.

Battlerage is a primary DPS skill tree with a heavy emphasis on close-range physical damage. It has several gap closers and some crowd control of its own, so it works with almost any other tree.
